assets.name: square-night
assets.prompt: A cozy storybook village square at night. Deep indigo starry sky, a crescent moon upper left lighting cobbles from the upper left. Small whimsical cottages frame a broad open center. An empty wooden lantern cart low in the center, low wheels and carved wood grain. An empty curved rope high across the sky. Warm window pinpoints, velvety shadows, rich layered foreground plants and cobbles. The middle is clear for large game pieces. No creatures, people, signs, text, letters or logos.

assets.name: street-night
assets.prompt: A continuous four-section storybook night-street panorama. Indigo starry sky and distant rolling hills in the upper third, a low ochre garden wall in the middle distance, generous textured cobblestone paving in the lower half. Amber lantern light from upper left, tactile masonry, ivy leaves and terracotta flowerpots. Clear space in every quarter for six game shop cutouts and signs. Rope overhead. No shops, people, creatures, lettering, numbers or logos. Match the existing warm gouache and colored-pencil house style. The low wall must not fill the scene.
